description: Ask in plain words how to land a payment, e.g. 'land 500 EUR in Douala on MTN today' or 'USD 25,000 to a supplier in Lagos'. Returns clean JSON: the payment as understood (amount, currencies, country, payout method, operator), the official rate (legal peg or central bank) and the street rate as separate dated fields, and the routes on record ordered by evidence of what landed. A route without enough landed evidence says "not enough evidence yet" and has no rank. Each route carries cost against the mid-market rate where a public price exists, landing time, delay risk, licence, limit and sources with dates; the answer is signed (verify at POST https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/attestations/verify). Free view without a key; every route's full evidence: USD 0.25 per call by x402 in USDC on Base, or a paid key. The same search is GET https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/search?q=... Information, not advice: SwapEazi never sends or holds money; the payer's own bank or provider does.

access_key.description: A paid key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

q.description: The payment in plain words: amount, currency, where it lands, and how (bank, mobile money, cash, stablecoin) if it matters.
